controls.title: OT vulnerabilities and threats
controls.description: Catalogues common ICS/OT vulnerabilities and integrity threats arising from IT/OT convergence.

controls.title: Data security
controls.description: Addresses confidentiality of OT data and information disclosure, including data at rest and in transit.

controls.title: Supply chain threats
controls.description: Covers third-party and supply chain risks to OT components and software.

controls.title: Availability threats
controls.description: Addresses denial-of-service and availability risks affecting OT systems and infrastructure.

controls.title: Risk assessment
controls.description: Guides identification of threats, vulnerabilities, and impacts for OT systems.

controls.title: Risk response
controls.description: Defines treatment of identified OT risks, including supply chain risk management.

controls.title: Security architecture
controls.description: Establishes secure OT architecture principles, including separation of OT from corporate networks.

controls.title: Network segmentation and defense-in-depth
controls.description: Specifies layered network architecture and validated data flows across zone boundaries.

controls.title: Data protection
controls.description: Defines protection of OT data at rest and in transit through encryption and access controls.

controls.title: Security awareness and training
controls.description: Covers OT security awareness, role-based training, and security programme governance.

controls.title: Supply chain risk management programme
controls.description: Establishes a formal OT supply chain risk management programme for vendors and components.
